purpose: Review-only independent rifle geometry and body-relative depth attachment rendered through twelve true-yaw views before rigging or runtime integration.
facing: twelve true-yaw weapon views at 30-degree steps plus twelve body-relative attachment-depth probes
lighting: neutral diagnostic lighting; orange is a technical separation material rather than production texturing
prompt: Using the locked player_weapon.png as the exact rifle identity, create one strict three-view technical sheet with left side elevation, right side elevation, and front/muzzle end view. Preserve the charcoal hard-surface silhouette, orange core and barrel accents, and thin cyan edge lights. Use orthographic projection, equal scale, flat neutral illumination, and a uniform #00ff00 chroma-key background. Include no character, hands, perspective, cast shadow, text, labels, or transparency.
negative_constraints: no whole-sprite rotation, 2D billboard, mirrored fake reverse side, or fused body-and-weapon mesh
no perspective, three-quarter camera, inconsistent barrel length, floating components, or flat zero-thickness result
no claim that the orange diagnostic material is final texturing
no final grip pose, rigging, animation, 120-frame atlas, or Player.gd integration before approval

references.role: approved rifle identity, silhouette, and palette
left-side elevation mapped to official front view
right-side elevation mapped to official back view
muzzle/end thickness mapped to official right view
approved body geometry used only for attachment-depth calibration

generation_model: built-in image generation tool, local chroma-key removal, official tencent/Hunyuan3D-2mv shape checkpoint, seed 20260812, 30 steps, octree 256

runtime_evidence.alpha_report: three transparent orthographic inputs with transparent corners and non-empty subject masks
